format: constants: the #define, static const, constexpr and enum values of the files; numbers are evaluated with STD_SCREEN_X = STD_SCREEN_Y = 0 (positions inside the std640 frame) and the names of the shared tables; a string is a symbol (a font macro or another identifier) or a VFS path; stdScreen: the names whose value contains STD_SCREEN_X or STD_SCREEN_Y; skipped: names whose value is not a constant (runtime values, function calls); panelRelative: the names whose value contains INTERFACE_START_X, INTERFACE_START_Y or INV_INTERFACE_START_Y, evaluated as 0 (positions inside the tactical panel frames)
